headline: Voted to enter non-public session under RSA 91-A:3, II (b) and (c).
summary: Mayor Champlin opened the session. Councilors then voted to go into non-public session under state law, and later voted to leave that session and end the meeting. Jennifer Johnston, director of human resources and labor relations, was the staff member present.
plain_text:
Ad-Hoc City Manager Search Committee 
Draft Meeting Minutes 
November 9, 2026  
City Council Chambers 
37 Green Street  
5:30 PM 
1. Mayor Champlin called the meeting to order at 5:31 p.m. 
 
2. Roll Call.  
 
Present: Councilor Brown, Mayor Champlin, Councilors Davie, Fennessy, Foote, Grady 
Sexton, Horne, Keach, Kretovic, Kurtz, Schlosser and Todd 
 
Late: Councilors Kalob, Schultz and Sekou  
 
Staff Member Present: Jennifer Johnston, Director of Human Resources and Labor 
Relations.  
 
3. Non-public session in accordance with RSA 91-A:3, II (b) and (c) 
 
Action:  At 5:32 p.m., Councilor Kurtz made a motion to enter non-public session in 
accordance with RSA 91-A:3, II (b) and (c).  The motion was duly seconded and passed 
with no dissenting votes. 
 
4. Adjournment. 
 
Action: At 6:42 p.m., Councilor Kretovic moved to exit the non-public session and adjourn 
the Ad-Hoc City Manager Search Committee meeting.  The motion was duly seconded and 
passed with no dissenting votes. 
 
A true copy: I attest:
